review_candidates.title: Chief of Staff
review_candidates.description: ABOUT UMER & COMPANY Umer & Company (UmerCo) is a boutique IBM integration consultancy and certified IBM reseller headquartered in Austin, TX. We specialize in IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration (IWHI), IBM Sterling B2B Integrator, and the broader IBM automation and integration ecosystem. We work with US based Fortune 500 enterprise clients across manufacturing, pharma, automotive, banking, and distribution, with a growing team across the US and our delivery office in Lahore, Pakistan. We’re in the middle of a real scale-up. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Chief of Staff, based in our Lahore office, to serve as the operating partner to the CEO. Today the CEO personally runs every department: operations, sales, engineering, technology, accounting, and the PMO, plus active client delivery for the larger engagements and a growing media company, 90s Kids. Your job is to replicate how he runs them so he doesn’t have to run them alone. You’ll track daily progress across every department and every project that matters to him, surface what’s stalled or off-track before he has to ask, and drive the follow-through. You’ll also be present in the sales cycle for larger deals, keep every active deal moving, protect the CEO’s time, direct the administrative and support staff across Lahore and the US. This role reports directly to the CEO and works day-to-day alongside the Lahore office manager. The entire company, including the Lahore team, operates on US Eastern/Central Time. You will too. When things are moving fast and the CEO is heads-down closing, you’re the operational spine. When he’s wrong, you say so. WHAT YOU’LL OWN – Daily progress tracking across every department: operations, sales, engineering, technology, accounting, PMO – Daily progression on everything high priority – 90s Kids: tracking projects and priorities alongside the company – The CEO’s operating cadence: standups, weekly reviews, scorecards, follow-ups – Full sales cycle: help drive deal momentum and tracking – IBM and TD SYNNEX relationship support – Calendar management: CEO time protected – Direction of the Lahore Sales and support staff – Business Development budget ownership and strategic deployment – Gatekeeper for new hires supporting the CEO – The honest voice to the CEO when it’s needed WHAT YOU BRING – You’ve operated across functions: you can hold sales, delivery, finance, and technology in your head at once – Enterprise software experience: channel, partner, technical sales, or delivery – IBM, TD SYNNEX, or similar channel experience is a strong plus – Fluent, client-ready written and spoken English – You build process where none exists without being asked – You follow through without being chased, manage up without being told – Based in Lahore, working from the office, fully committed to US Eastern/Central Time hours long term

review_candidates.title: Channel Account Manager EMEA, Matterport - London
review_candidates.description: Job Description COSTAR GROUP - SENIOR CHANNEL ACCOUNT MANAGER EMEA, MATTERPORT - LONDON Overview CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index and the NASDAQ 100, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate. About Matterport Matterport, part of the Costar Group, is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our groundbreaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 177 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing. Learn more about Matterport. Description The Senior Channel Account Manager (CAM) is responsible for developing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with channel partners and Value-Added Resellers (VAR) to drive sales and expand market reach. This role involves building strong partner relationships, enabling partners with training and resources, and ensuring mutual business success through joint planning, performance monitoring, and execution. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious, highly motivated channel salesperson to be on the front line, selling solutions and services with their partners across several industries including but not limited to AEC, Commercial Real Estate, Retail, Facilities Management. They thrive in a fast-paced environment, winning and exceeding targets. Responsibilities Deliver Quarterly Channel targets - SaaS and Services This is achieved by supporting their partners in building the right pipeline & book of business to sell to their end clients. Be operationally excellent in the day-to-day running of your partner territory by accurately forecasting weekly, monthly and quarterly numbers. Excellent application of Sales tools such as SFDC, Groove, Highspot. Channel Development Identify, recruit, and onboard new channel partners aligned with company goals. Develop & update business plans with partners quarterly to drive revenue and achieve sales targets. Relationship Management Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with partners and key stakeholders. Build Exec relationships with the VAR & Matterport. Serve as the main point of contact for assigned channel partners. Sales Enablement & Support Provide training, tools, and support to help partners effectively position and sell products/services with SFDC, CPQ and PRM. Deliver sales, technical presentations & demo’s to new & existing partners via both web presentations and on site presentations including our Pro 3D camera. Collaborate with internal sales and marketing teams to execute channel programs and campaigns. Performance Tracking Monitor partner sales performance, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy. Analyse data to identify growth opportunities and address performance gaps. Market & Competitive Insights Stay up to date with industry trends, competitive offerings, and market shifts. Share partner and market feedback with internal teams to inform product and strategy development. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience required. Excellent English & German written, verbal and presentation skills. A track record of commitment to prior employers. Proven track record in Channel sales across EMEA with extensive experience in SaaS sales. Able to travel and be in region to support your partner in co selling and business planning. Familiar with Value Based solution selling using ROI and the MEDDPICC sales methodology with Partners to their end clients. History of achieving 100% Channel sales quotas (SAAS, ACV). Experience working in the SaaS Technology Space serving clients in one or many of these industries; Commercial or Residential Real Estate, Facilities Management, Manufacturing, Travel & Hospitality, Construction. Must be energetic, team player, presentable and professional. We want to hear from you! We are looking to build the best team of people who will be empowered to do their best work. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? Working at CoStar Group means you'll enjoy a culture of collaboration and innovation that attracts the best and brightest across a broad range of disciplines. As well as having an outstanding working environment based in the Blue Fin or one of our key UK-wide hubs. Other perks include full private medical cover, dental cover, Life Assurance and member rewards, 28 days annual leave, a competitive pension, season ticket loans, enhanced maternity and paternity pay and much more! At CoStar, we recognise the positive value of diversity and promote equality. We aim at all times to recruit the person who is most suited to the job and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds including but not limited to; people of all genders, of all ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, nationalities, religions and beliefs. #Matterport

review_candidates.title: CFA 2026 001 | Project Assistant (Response) | Roster only
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope This Call for Applications aims to establish a roster of qualified candidates who may be mobilized to support the Mission’s surge staffing requirements during disasters, emergencies, and other humanitarian response operations. Please note that there is currently no confirmed start date or immediate deployment opportunity associated with this roster. The engagement of roster members will depend on operational requirements, the nature and scale of emergency responses, funding and budget availability, and the Mission’s staffing needs. Candidates who submit an application acknowledge their interest in being considered for future emergency response assignments and are expected to maintain their availability should their services be required. If selected for deployment or engagement, roster members must be locally available and be prepared to promptly complete all necessary onboarding, documentation, and administrative requirements within the prescribed timeframe. As part of your application, kindly submit a cover letter indicating any relevant experience in emergency response and/or the following areas: Shelter, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), Cash-Based Interventions (CBI), Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), Community Mobilization, Information Management and Reporting, and Health. Your cover letter should briefly describe your experience, key responsibilities, and any relevant skills or training related to these areas. Responsibilities Assist in the implementation, coordination, and monitoring of emergency response activities, ensuring the timely delivery of humanitarian assistance in accordance with project objectives, humanitarian principles, and donor requirements. Retrieve, compile, analyse, summarise, and present information and data on disaster impacts, humanitarian needs, response activities, and operational developments to support evidence-based planning and decision-making. Monitor project budget implementation by verifying the availability of funds, obtaining the necessary approvals, and updating budget-related information to support efficient and accountable emergency response operations. Support the administrative and operational coordination of emergency response activities, liaising with internal units, government counterparts, humanitarian partners, and service providers to facilitate procurement, logistics, deployments, clearances, and other operational requirements. Draft situation reports, implementation updates, and progress reports, identify operational challenges and delivery gaps, and bring critical issues to the attention of the supervisor with recommendations for corrective action. Draft correspondence, briefing notes, donor reports, presentations, dashboards, statistical tables, and other operational documentation to support coordination, reporting, and emergency response decision-making. Organize coordination meetings, workshops, simulations, and capacity-building activities for government counterparts, humanitarian partners, and response personnel to strengthen emergency preparedness and response capacities. Respond to operational information requests and maintain project files and records, ensuring accurate documentation of emergency response activities, beneficiary data, and project outputs. Perform any other duties as assigned to support emergency preparedness, response, early recovery, and resilience-building activities. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Humanities, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or, High School diploma with four years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in liaising with governmental authorities, national/international institutions, United Nations agencies and non-governmental organisations; Experience in working with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups; and, Prior work experience with international humanitarian organisations, non-government or government institutions/organisation in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage. Skills Knowledge of emergency preparedness, disaster response, and humanitarian operations in the Philippines. Strong understanding of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), Climate Change Adaptation (CCA), and humanitarian principles and standards. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical and donor reporting. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, Tagalog is required Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

review_candidates.title: Business Development Executive
review_candidates.description: Location: Salford Quays (Hybrid) Join Apadmi as a Business Development Executive! Joining an award-winning global leader in mobile technology and integration, you will focus on identifying opportunities, building relationships from scratch, and confidently engaging senior decision-makers. You’ll collaborate closely with Growth Directors and Marketing to align outreach with strategic campaigns, acting as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients as Apadmi continues its international growth. We’re looking for a proactive Business Development Executive to join Apadmi and play a key role in generating new business opportunities across industries spanning Retail, Financial Services, Insurance and more, throughout the UK, Europe, USA and Sri Lanka. Working from our Salford Quays HQ, you will build a strong sales pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting and multi-channel engagement. This is a role for someone who thrives on prospecting, enjoys picking up the phone, and is energised by creating opportunities where others see dead ends. What you’ll be working on In this outbound sales development role, you will research, identify, and prospect into target accounts across your dedicated markets. You will own your pipeline of activity using modern sales tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Salesloft to consistently generate qualified meetings. By testing and refining your approach, you will drive new business pipeline while representing Apadmi at industry events and exceeding activity targets. Research, identify, and prospect into target accounts using tailored, multi-channel outbound campaigns. Build relationships with senior stakeholders through proactive cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and creative outreach techniques. Generate qualified sales opportunities that directly contribute to Apadmi’s strategic new business pipeline. Focus on driving outbound growth across a range of sectors all over the world. Manage a consistent, disciplined pipeline of activity using Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Salesloft. Collaborate with Growth Directors and Marketing to align messaging with strategic campaigns and account lists. Represent Apadmi at relevant industry events to connect with decision-makers and build brand awareness. Continuously test, refine, and optimise your outreach techniques to hit and exceed pipeline targets. What You’ll Bring To The Team You are a resilient, self-motivated sales professional with a proven track record in outbound prospecting and account generation. You are confident picking up the phone, engaging senior stakeholders, and navigating complex corporate structures. Curious and coachable, you thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess the organisation and persistence needed to turn cold prospects into high-value sales opportunities. Proven experience as a BDE or SDR with a history of generating qualified outbound meetings. Highly confident making cold calls and engaging senior decision-makers across target organisations. Experience working towards and exceeding activity, meeting, and pipeline creation KPIs. Experience selling into or prospecting within the Retail, Financial Services and/or Insurance sectors is advantageous. Practical experience using Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Salesloft). Exceptionally persistent, comfortable handling rejection, and motivated to create opportunities. Excellent time management skills with the discipline to manage high-volume activity effectively. Driven by continuous personal development, eagerness to learn, and adapting to evolving business priorities. What Success Looks Like You consistently generate high-quality meetings with target organisations. You become a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients. Your outbound activity is disciplined, consistent and creative. You work closely with sales and marketing to continually improve campaign performance. You're recognised as someone who doesn't wait for opportunities to appear - you create them. Why Apadmi? Be part of a collaborative, award-winning team with a vibrant culture. Unlock career growth through our Apadmi Academy and structured development opportunities. Hybrid working from our modern HQ in Salford Quays. The opportunity to play a key role in growing Apadmi’s international footprint.

review_candidates.title: Business Development Consultant
review_candidates.description: London HQ | Hybrid (Moorgate) As Signify Technology enters its tenth year, we are continuing to invest in the development of our UK & EU client partnerships from our London headquarters. This role exists as a result of sustained growth across our US client base and the need to continue developing meaningful, consultative partnerships with organisations who require more than transactional recruitment support. As a Business Development Consultant aligned to our US market, you will focus on establishing and developing strategic hiring relationships with technology businesses. Working closely with our delivery teams, you will support clients across a range of hiring models, ensuring that we are positioned as a long-term partner rather than a short-term supplier. Responsibilities Developing new client relationships within the UK / EU tech market Identifying and generating new business opportunities Managing end-to-end recruitment processes across contract and permanent hiring Delivering against individual and multi-hire client requirements Building candidate networks within your market Managing stakeholder expectations throughout the hiring process Contributing to the growth of longer-term client partnerships Requirements Previous experience in a Business Development role within a technology recruitment environment Experience working within the UK / EU technology market A track record of consistent billing within a recruitment setting Experience developing and managing hiring partnerships within Software Engineering, Data, Machine Learning or AI markets Strong commercial awareness and ability to sell hiring solutions Ability to operate within a high-performance environment Why Signify? Signify has grown consistently in revenue year-on-year since opening and now operates as a predominantly contract-focused consultancy business, with the majority of our work centred around long-term contract and project delivery. Our consultants are not restricted to selling a single hiring model. Instead, they are supported to operate as hiring partners across both contract and permanent hiring, as well as embedded and project-based solutions. This enables broader client partnerships and access to more stable revenue streams than reliance on individual placements alone. We operate a no-threshold commission structure designed to reward consistent performance across a quarterly period, with consultants able to earn up to 40% commission and no cap on earnings. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Diversity, equity and inclusion sit at the core of how we operate as a business. We are committed to creating an environment where individuals from all backgrounds feel supported, valued and able to succeed. We take an active approach to ensuring our workplace is inclusive, respectful and representative of the communities we partner with. We do not tolerate exclusionary or discriminatory behaviour in any form and expect all employees to contribute to maintaining a collaborative and inclusive working environment. Why You’ll Love Working at Signify Your Career Should Be Rewarding In Every Way - That’s Why We Offer Perks Designed To Fuel Your Success, Wellbeing, And Life Outside Of Work. Here’s What That Looks Like Flexible working structure – hybrid setup of 2 days working-from-home, flexible hours, and 3pm early finish Fridays. Generous time-off – 25 days of annual leave that increases by 1 day per work anniversary (up to 10 years), your birthday off, Christmas office closure, and wellness days when we hit company milestones. Private Medical Insurance – includes private GP access, annual dental, vision, and hearing reimbursement, and up to 50% off selected gyms. Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - access to mental health support, therapy, and professional advice for personal matters, such as financial concerns. Pension scheme – 5% employee contribution matched by Signify with salary sacrifice options to boost your savings. Uncapped commission for Sales and performance-based rewards that truly recognise your success. Paid sabbatical every 5 years - take up to 2 months to travel, study, or recharge. Inclusive family support - 6 months fully paid maternity leave and 1 month fully paid paternity leave, inclusive of adoption and surrogacy leave. Life insurance (4x base salary) and Critical illness cover (2x base salary). Eco-friendly commuting - Ride to Work Scheme and Electric Vehicle Scheme. Learning & Development - annual learning allowance, funding for professional accreditations and global conferences, and access to advanced professional training. Travel insurance – covers both work and personal trips. Annual Incentive Trip for top performers - destinations have included Mykonos, Mexico, and the Bahamas. Quarterly socials – explore new venues and experiences together: crazy golf, yoga, shuffleboard and more. About Learn more about what makes Signify one of the best places to work on our Careers Page , and see why our culture has earned us recognition such as: Recruitment Agency of the Year – 35–49 Employees (2025) Best Recruitment Company to Work For (2024) Sunday Times – Best Places to Work (2024) Best Places to Work in Tech (2023) Best Places for Wellbeing (2023) Leader of the Year (Agency) (2022) Most Inspiring Recruitment Agency Leader (2022) Diversity and Inclusion Champion (2022) APSCo Embrace Award (2021) Agency of the Year (2021) Best Place to Work (2021) CEO of the Year (2021) Agency of the Year (2020) International Business of the Year (2020) Best New Agency (2019)

review_candidates.title: Automation Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: Are you a skilled multi-disciplinary engineer looking for a role that challenges and rewards? We’re seeking a Automation Maintenance Engineer, at our Manchester Mail Centre, 77 Oldham Road, Manchester, M4 5AA site, to ensure the smooth running of our cutting-edge automation systems. Royal Mail is undergoing one of the biggest technological transformations in its history , moving to a predominantly mechanised parcel sortation process . With a major investment in state-of-the-art automation technology , this is an exciting time to join us and help shape the future of delivery services in an ever-growing e-commerce society . In this role your potential earning will be over £55,000 per annum. Salary: £54,791 per annum, plus night shift allowance, 22.5 days annual leave with bank holidays and a defined contribution pension scheme. A weekend supplement for Saturday (£54.73 per attendance) and Sunday (£109.47 per attendance) shift attendance is applicable. You may be eligible for a welcome bonus of £1,500* Payments are made in instalments and subject to terms and conditions. Contract: Permanent. Hours: Shift attendance equates to 40 hours per week - Full time. The successful candidate will be required to follow the location’s shift rotation system, as outlined below with some degree of flexibility to meet our 24/7 operational needs on occasion, including voluntary overtime coverage and occasional shift pattern flexibility. The role will cover early, late and night shifts. A typical shift rota is below: Lates - 13:45 - 22:00 Monday to Friday Earlies - 07:00 - 14:00 Monday to Friday / Saturday 18:00 - 07:00 Sunday Nights - 20:00 Sunday - 07:15 / Monday - Sat am 21:45 - 07:15 Rest - Monday to Friday / Saturday and Sunday 07:00 - 18:00 The Role Keep our automation assets performing at their best through preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance. Drive continuous improvement projects from concept to implementation. Collaborate with the Engineering Manager and team leaders, completing reports and logging faults. Diagnose and resolve automation breakdowns quickly to keep operations flowing. Monitor performance and work with stakeholders to boost output. Take ownership of Continuous Improvement projects — from concept to implementation — focused on enhancing machinery performance in our Hub/Mail Centre. About You Qualified in electrical and mechanical engineering (minimum ONC Electrical Engineering / NVQ Level 3 or equivalent). Experienced in maintaining automation equipment, ideally with PLC knowledge. Strong understanding of Health & Safety legislation. A proactive team player who can also work independently. Full manual UK driving licence (for occasional travel to other sites). What happens next? After initial application, any shortlisted candidates will to attend an assessment, incorporating practical elements and a competency based interview. You’ll also be asked to supply proof any quoted formal qualifications at this interview. Job reference number 339239

review_candidates.title: Associate | Eminence, Media & Digital Marketing | Lebanon
review_candidates.description: About Deloitte: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award. Our Purpose Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities. Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact: Lead the way Serve with integrity Take care of each other Foster inclusion Collaborate for measurable impact During your tenure as an Associate - Digital Experience, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas: As a Digital Experience Associate, you will support the delivery and operations of Deloitte Middle East’s digital platforms by coordinating web requests, maintaining high-quality content execution, supporting SEO and analytics processes, and ensuring smooth stakeholder workflows. This role is ideal for an early-career digital professional who is organized, detail-oriented, and eager to build expertise in web experience, measurement, and digital operations in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Website management & coordination Serve as the first point of contact for day-to-day digital platform requests from Growth and business stakeholders. Execute content updates on the site backends and enhance the user experience and journey by clearly understanding site templates, do’s and don’ts. Translate requests into clear briefs (objective, audience, content, CTA, deadlines, approvals) and route work to the right owners (Web/Analytics Associate, Web Admin, tool specialists) under the Manager’s direction. Maintain trackers, follow up on approvals, and provide timely status updates to stakeholders. Content operations & quality assurance Coordinate content updates for Deloitte.com and internal platforms, ensuring readiness for publishing (correct format, links, metadata, approvals). Perform QA checks pre- and post-go-live (broken links, page layout issues, correct CTAs, basic accessibility checks, correct tagging requests submitted). Support content hygiene initiatives (page inventories, content audits, archiving, governance compliance). SEO support Support SEO execution by coordinating on-page requirements (titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking) and tracking basic performance indicators. Assist with Search Console checks and compile recurring SEO snapshots. Analytics & reporting support Pull routine reports and dashboards (web traffic, top pages, campaign landing page performance) and consolidate inputs into monthly performance packs. Support tagging/UTM governance by ensuring requests include measurement requirements and that stakeholders follow standards. Digital marketing campaign coordination and support Support digital marketing campaign delivery by coordinating inputs (briefs, copy, creative, audience/segmentation requirements, approvals, timelines) and creating it where necessary. Assist with basic digital marketing platform coordination to enhance KPIs. Compile recurring campaign performance inputs into standardized reporting packs. Tooling & process support Support the Digital team in maintaining documentation, playbooks, and training materials for stakeholders (how to request updates, how to brief pages, measurement basics).
